title: VQA for Dynamic Portfolio Optimization: Sampling Strategies, Optimizer Scheduling, and Hardware-Aware Ansatz Design
summary: Variational quantum algorithms are increasingly explored for optimization problems at scales relevant to near-term quantum devices. Their practical performance depends strongly on design choices such as the sampling objective, classical optimizer, and ansatz layout before and after hardware transpilation. We study these factors for dynamic portfolio optimization, a multi-period financial problem balancing return, risk, transaction costs, cash-interest effects, and constraints.
